A detailed review of Best Life insurance from Aditya Birla Sun Life insurance (absli) - Aditya Birla Digishield Plan. Life insurance is a critical investment for a family and we recommend taking up Term life insurance. We have reviewed the best life insurance of 2022 and in that series here we are reviewing Life Insurance from Aditya Birla Sun Life. 
Aditya Birla sun life is a joint venture of Aditya Birla Capital and Sun Life insurance. The Digishield plan from Aditya Birla Sun Life insurance is a very good option for Term Life Insurance. 
Aditya Birla Sun life insurance is offered in both online and offline mode. You can buy Digi Shield Plan from www.adityabirlacapital.com or from Policybazaar.com. There is 1% discount on online purchases. 
Aditya Birla Capital Sun Life is offering Life insurance for 20+ years and is one of the 10 life insurance companies in India. The claim settlement ratio of Aditya Birla Life insurance is 98% which is a good ratio to have. 
Some important pointers of Birla Sun Life insurance are 
1. Sum assured is minimum 50 Lakh and maximum depends on the factors like health, income etc.
2. Entry age: Minimum entry age is 18 years and the maximum is 65 years.
3. Maximum maturity age of 85 Years but can be 99 Years as well.
4.  Premium payment term can be single pay, limited pay or Regular pay.
